notes.title: 🚀 The Update is Live!
notes.notes:
Hey Survivors,

The wait is over — today’s update is officially live! Jump in now and try out all the new systems, fixes, and improvements we’ve been working on.
[hr][/hr]🔫 Gameplay & Combat
💥 Rocket Launcher – Bring the big boom to your fights!

⚡ Dash Ability – Press Shift once to quickly dash in the direction you want.

🧟 Zombie Behavior Update – Zombies Explosive no longer explode instantly on collision. They now explode 2 seconds after death, making encounters more strategic.

[hr][/hr]🎮 Systems & Mechanics
🎚️ Item Level System – Items now have required levels. You can only equip them if your character level is high enough.

🪜 Ladder System – Climb your way to new places with the new ladder mechanic.

🎁 Redeem Code System – You can now claim rewards with special redeem codes!
👉 Go to the Event Tab in your Inventory, enter the code Demo2025, and receive a special gift.

[hr][/hr]🗺️ Exploration & Survival

See you in the wasteland,
Althurius \[UNRL]

notes.title: 📝 Dev Update – Early Access, But a Full Game
notes.notes:
Hello Survivors,

I want to share some details about how \[Game Name] will launch and evolve.
🎮 Early Access – Already Complete
The game will release in Early Access, but unlike many Early Access titles, it will already be a complete experience from the start:

✅ A finished map (no fake walls, no empty placeholders)

✅ All planned weapons, items, and zombies included

✅ A seasonal event system with collectibles you can trade to NPCs for rewards

So while it’s labeled Early Access, you’ll be playing the full game from day one.
🔧 Why Early Access?
The main reason is to make sure the game gets:

Thorough bug fixing based on wider player testing

Polish and balance updates where needed

Ongoing support with new items, seasonal events, and improvements

Once the game is fully stable and polished, it will leave Early Access and become a complete release.

🌐 Offline Play (Coming Later)
For players who prefer solo play without a Steam connection, an offline version will be made available after release. This way you’ll be able to enjoy the game fully in single-player mode even without being online or connected to steam.

[hr][/hr]
👉 Thanks for joining me on this journey! Your feedback during Early Access will be key to making sure the final polished release is the best it can be.

— Shatterland Dev
